dedupe_keys.name: cairn energy system simulation and optimisation suite

description: Cairn is an energy and environmental system modelling suite developed by CEA-Liten. It represents technical components and operates or sizes them under scenarios, with a graphical viewer and a Python API. Users provide component specifications, demand and resource series, operating constraints and an objective; outputs are simulated energy flows, configuration choices and environmental or economic indicators for the selected system and period. Geographic coverage is a user-defined plant or network. EPL-2.0 source, release information and documentation are public. The README lists Windows support and HiGHS, with CPLEX optional for some solver choices. A limitation is that software optimisation cannot validate local tariffs, permits or equipment feasibility without case data. Cairn can compare district heating, generation and industrial energy-system configurations. The catalogue's model-pypsa is a separate electricity-system optimiser, not the same package. No release installer, input series or model run was downloaded.
